description: This file contains a unit test class `VaultProviderTest` for testing the behavior of the `VaultProvider` content provider, including creation, deletion, and querying of documents within a vault-like structure.

classes.name: VaultProviderTest
classes.description: A test suite for the VaultProvider content provider, testing document creation, deletion, and querying functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, acquiring the content provider client and wiping all contents before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteDirectory
methods.description: Tests deleting a directory and verifying that its documents are also removed, along with subsequent queries.

methods.name: assertContains
methods.description: Checks if the cursor contains documents with the specified display names.
